nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Tesla Capital Corp'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'TeslaCapital'.
Public uint8 state variable defining token decimals (10).
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply.
Mapping(address => uint) holding balances of token holders.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd: adds two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a and performs subtraction.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: requires b > 0 and performs integer division.
TeslaCapital constructor: sets metadata, mints full supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
ERC20 totalSupply view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
ERC20 balanceOf view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 allowance view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
ERC20 approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
ERC20 transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowance without an explicit allowance check.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for balances and allowances.
Addition c = a + b followed by require(c >= a) inside safeAdd (arithmetic overflow check).
Subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) inside safeSub (arithmetic underflow check).
Multiplication c = a * b followed by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside safeMul.
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) inside safeDiv.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom, allowance is not verified before spending.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom.

edges.reason: safeAdd parameter a participates in c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeAdd parameter b participates in c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub parameter a participates in c = a - b.
safeSub parameter b is checked in require(b <= a) and subtracted.
safeMul parameter a participates in c = a * b overflow check.
safeMul parameter b participates in c = a * b overflow check.
safeDiv parameter a is the dividend.
safeDiv parameter b is required to be > 0 before division.
Addition result is stored into local c of safeAdd.
Subtraction result is stored into local c of safeSub.
Multiplication result is stored into local c of safeMul.
Division result is stored into local c of safeDiv.
tokenOwner indexes balances mapping to produce the returned balance.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
balances mapping is read by balanceOf.
allowed mapping is read by allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] for an arbitrary spender.
tokens amount is written unchecked into the allowed mapping.
tokens amount is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
tokens amount is added to balances[to] in transfer.
recipient address indexes the balances mapping in safeAdd.
tokens amount is subtracted from balances[from] in transferFrom.
tokens amount is subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
tokens amount is added to balances[to] in transferFrom.
from address indexes the balances mapping being decremented.
from address is used in the emitted Transfer event and balance lookup.
to address indexes the balances mapping being incremented.
balances mapping is read and written inside transfer.
balances mapping is read and written inside transferFrom.
allowed mapping is read and written inside transferFrom without a sufficient-allowance require.
transfer executes the safeSub operation on the sender balance.
transfer executes the safeAdd operation on the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes safeSub on balances[from].
transferFrom executes safeSub on allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom executes safeAdd on balances[to].
msg.sender determines which allowance slot approve writes.
msg.sender determines the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
balances[msg.sender] is credited with the initial supply.
constructor assigns the name state variable.
constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
constructor assigns _totalSupply.
constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.

Parameter b only flows into the addition safe operation inside safeAdd.
Parameter a only flows into the subtraction safe operation inside safeSub.
Parameter b only flows into the guarded subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter a only flows into the multiplication safe operation inside safeMul.
Parameter b only flows into the multiplication safe operation inside safeMul.
Parameter a is the dividend of the division safe operation inside safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor validated inside safeDiv.
tokenOwner is used only as the lookup key of the balanceOf view function.
tokenOwner is used only as the lookup key of the allowance view function.
spender is used only as the lookup key of the allowance view function.
spender indexes the allowance written by approve.
tokens is the value written into the allowance by approve.
to is only used as the recipient key inside transfer.
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transfer.
from is only used as the debited account key inside transferFrom.
to is only used as the credited account key inside transferFrom.
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transferFrom.
